title: A Spare Helmet and Three Weeks' Training: SafeBoda's Kampala Start
conflicts: Kenya exit was November 2020, not 2022 as slated. Riders affected in Kenya: Nation and Business Daily say hundreds lost jobs (network of more than 4,000), TechCabal says about 4,000 lost jobs; the story gives the range. Start date: CNN gives November 2014, The Observer (2019) says operations officially began 2015; story uses November 2014. Helmet-uptake figures (MIT TR 2017, NPR 2018, Rapa 2019) disagree and are left out except that most passengers declined helmets in 2017.
notes: Told as the founding and first riders, with the 2020 Nairobi pause and 2024 return as aftermath; arc set to founding-decision. The Observer's 2025 SafeBoda@10 piece and Matooke Republic share near-identical company-supplied text and are treated as one company account. No earlier SafeBoda or Kampala transport story exists in offline/editions.
